title: Create session request
description: Body of POST /sessions. The player comes from the access token in the Authorization header (Bearer), which must carry the play scope. Either play one of the account's characters in the world, or train: a single fight against an encounter, with no character. Opening a session closes the account's open session, if any (close code 4409).

oneOf.title: Play a character
oneOf.description: Opens or resumes the character where it is, a fight in progress included. Its map and sets belong to it (see POST /characters).

oneOf.title: Train
oneOf.description: A fight-only session against an encounter. Changes no character.

sets.description: Optional. The gear sets the Scribe prepares; the first one is active. Defaults to the starting loadout.

seed.description: Optional. The same seed and the same actions always give the same fight.
